description: Send one query to You.com, Tavily, Exa and Parallel right now, using the API keys set in your own environment (YDC_API_KEY, TAVILY_API_KEY, EXA_API_KEY, PARALLEL_API_KEY; providers without a key are skipped). Returns each provider's client-side latency, result count and top results. Calls use your own provider credits.

providers.description: Subset of You.com, Tavily, Exa, Parallel (default: all with a key)

query.description: The search query, e.g. one of the benchmark's search calls
